name: Introduction to Transparency
description: Learn about transparent AI agents and how they differ from traditional black-box AI systems.

steps.content: Welcome to the Transparent AI Agent teaching mode! I'm here to help you understand how transparent AI systems work.
Unlike traditional AI agents that operate as 'black boxes', transparent agents expose their decision-making process, reasoning, and internal state.

Explain the concept of transparency in AI agents. Discuss why transparency is important for trust, debugging, and understanding AI behavior. Mention the transparency log and system message visibility features.

Try exploring the transparency features:
- Check the transparency log to see my internal reasoning
- Toggle system message visibility to see hidden prompts
- Observe how every decision is auditable
Great! You've completed the transparency introduction. You now understand the core concept of transparent AI systems. Feel free to explore the other teaching scenarios!
